titleEn: Master Bathroom Renovation Cost Richmond BC 2026: Real Prices From $19,000
titleZh: 列治文主浴室裝修費用2026：真實價格從 $19,000 起
contentEn:
A master bathroom renovation in Richmond BC costs between $19,000 for a surface-level refresh and $75,000 or more for a full gut renovation with premium finishes, new plumbing layout, and structural changes. Reno Stars has completed 58 projects across Metro Vancouver including master bathroom renovations in Richmond, Vancouver, and North Vancouver. Every project carries a 3-year workmanship warranty and includes a free, no-obligation quote.

Master Bathroom Renovation Cost in Richmond: 2026 Price Guide

The final cost of your master bathroom depends on three variables: the scope of work, the grade of finishes you choose, and whether the plumbing layout changes. Use the table below as a planning anchor, then talk to our team for a quote tailored to your home.

Renovation ScopeEstimated Cost RangeWhat It Includes
Surface refresh$19,000 – $28,000New vanity, faucet, toilet, light fixtures, paint, and tile re-grout. Plumbing layout unchanged.
Mid-range renovation$28,000 – $45,000Full tile replacement (floor and shower), new glass shower enclosure, upgraded vanity and fixtures, new lighting, and vanity relocation within existing plumbing lines.
High-end renovation$45,000 – $65,000Custom millwork, curbless walk-in shower, heated floors, freestanding tub, upgraded plumbing, and premium stone or large-format tile throughout.
Luxury gut renovation$65,000 – $80,000+Complete demolition to studs, new plumbing layout, structural changes, steam shower, custom marble finishes, and smart fixtures. Workmanship warranty applies to all scopes.

What Drives the Cost of a Master Bathroom Renovation in Richmond

Beyond the base scope, four factors most commonly move a master bathroom budget up or down in Richmond:

  • Plumbing reconfiguration: Moving the toilet, shower, or double vanity requires a permit and rerouting drain lines. Each relocation adds $2,000–$6,000 in labour and permit fees.
  • Shower type: A standard alcove shower with a glass panel costs $2,500–$5,000 installed. A curbless walk-in shower with waterproofing and linear drain runs $6,000–$12,000. A steam shower enclosure with generator starts around $12,000.
  • Flooring material: Large-format porcelain tile on heated subfloor is the most common premium choice in Richmond bathrooms. Material and installation runs $4,500–$9,000 for a typical 120-square-foot master bath floor area.
  • Vanity and countertop: A custom solid-wood vanity with quartz countertop and undermount sinks ranges $3,500–$9,000 depending on size and finish.

Richmond-Specific Permit and Regulatory Costs

Any master bathroom renovation that modifies plumbing or electrical in Richmond requires a City of Richmond building permit. Electrical upgrades for new lighting or heated floors require a separate permit. Your contractor should handle permit applications — Reno Stars manages all City of Richmond permit filings as part of our standard project process. Permit fees for a typical master bathroom renovation run $800–$1,500 depending on scope.

How Long Does a Master Bathroom Renovation Take in Richmond

A surface refresh typically takes 3–4 weeks from demolition to final inspection. A mid-range or high-end renovation runs 6–10 weeks. A full gut renovation with plumbing changes requires 10–16 weeks including permit processing, material lead times for custom millwork, and City of Richmond inspections at each stage. All timelines assume a dedicated crew on-site daily and exclude material delivery delays beyond our control.

Project Examples: Master Bathroom Renovations by Reno Stars

These are real completed projects drawn from our portfolio:

  • Master Bathroom Renovation with Custom Features — Vancouver: Custom double vanity, curbless walk-in shower, heated floors. Mid-to-high range scope.
  • Luxury Curbless Shower Bathroom Renovation — North Vancouver: Premium curbless design, floating vanity, designer fixtures.
  • Two Bathroom Renovation with Custom Features — Burnaby: Master bath plus secondary bath renovated simultaneously, custom tile work throughout.

Planning a master bathroom renovation in Richmond? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars. Our showroom at 21300 Gordon Way in Richmond is open Monday through Saturday — you are welcome to see material samples and speak with our project team in person. Reno Stars serves Richmond, Vancouver, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey, Delta, New Westminster, and surrounding areas. Quotes include a detailed line-by-line scope, material selections guide, and projected timeline before any commitment.

Frequently Asked Questions About Master Bathroom Renovation Costs in Richmond

What is the average cost of a master bathroom renovation in Richmond BC in 2026?

The average master bathroom renovation in Richmond BC for a mid-range scope — new tile, upgraded vanity, walk-in shower, and updated lighting — runs $28,000 to $45,000 all-in including labour, materials, permits, and finishing. Surface refreshes start at $19,000. Luxury gut renovations with structural changes can exceed $75,000.

Do I need a permit for a master bathroom renovation in Richmond?

Yes. Any renovation that modifies plumbing, drainage, or electrical circuits in Richmond requires a City of Richmond building permit. Electrical upgrades for heated floors, new vanity lighting, or exhaust fans require a separate electrical permit. Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of our standard project management.

How long does a master bathroom renovation take in Richmond?

A surface-level master bathroom refresh takes 3–4 weeks. A mid-range renovation with new tile and a glass shower enclosure takes 6–10 weeks. A full gut renovation with plumbing changes takes 10–16 weeks from permit application to final inspection. All timelines include City of Richmond inspection stages.

What is the most expensive part of a master bathroom renovation?

The shower area — specifically the waterproofing, shower pan or curbless system, glass enclosure or frameless door, and any plumbing relocation — typically represents the single largest line item. After the shower, custom millwork and vanity, flooring material, and heated floor systems are the next biggest expenses.

Is a master bathroom renovation worth the cost in Richmond?

A mid-to-high range master bathroom renovation typically recovers 60–70% of its cost in increased home value for Richmond homeowners, based on comparable sales in the area. Beyond resale value, a well-designed master bathroom significantly improves day-to-day quality of life — particularly for primary suite occupants. A full renovation also eliminates deferred maintenance risks such as hidden mould, failing waterproofing, and outdated plumbing that could require emergency repair.

最終費用取決於三個關鍵因素：工程範圍、選材檔次，以及是否需要改動管道布局。以下價格表供規劃參考，歡迎聯絡我們獲取針對您房屋的詳細報價。

哪些因素影響列治文主浴室裝修費用

除了基本工程範圍，以下四個因素最常見於列治文主浴室裝修費用的增減：

  • 管道改動：移動馬桶、淋浴或雙洗手台需要許可證並重新鋪設排水管線。每移動一項，增加 $2,000–$6,000 的人工及許可費用。
  • 淋浴間類型：標準 alcove 淋浴間連玻璃面板費用為 $2,500–$5,000。無門檻步入式淋浴連防水及線性排水溝費用為 $6,000–$12,000。蒸汽淋浴間連發熱裝置起價約 $12,000。
  • 地面材料：列治文浴室最常見的高端選擇是大型瓷磚配合地暖。典型 120 平方英尺主浴室地面材料及安裝費用為 $4,500–$9,000。
  • 洗手台及枱面：定制實木洗手台連石英石枱面及台下盆，尺寸及飾面不同，費用為 $3,500–$9,000。

列治文特有的許可及監管費用

任何涉及列治文管道或電氣改動的主浴室裝修均需獲取列治文市建築許可證。電氣升級（如新照明或地暖）需要单独許可證。聚星裝修作為標準項目流程的一部分，代為處理所有列治文市許可證申請。典型主浴室裝修的許可證費用為 $800–$1,500，視乎工程範圍而定。

列治文主浴室裝修需要多長時間

表面更新通常需時 3–4 週，從拆除到最終檢查。中檔或高端裝修需時 6–10 週。全面翻新涉及管道改動者，需時 10–16 週，包括許可證申請、定制木作材料交貨時間，以及列治文市各階段檢查。所有時間線均假設每日有專門團隊在場，不包括我們無法控制的材料延遲。

關於列治文主浴室裝修費用的常見問題

2026 年列治文主浴室裝修的平均費用是多少？

列治文主浴室裝修中檔範圍（換瓷磚，升級洗手台，walk-in 淋浴，更新照明）的平均費用為 $28,000 至 $45,000，含人工、材料、許可證及裝修。表面更新起價 $19,000。涉及結構改建的高端豪華翻新可超過 $75,000。

列治文主浴室裝修需要許可證嗎？

需要。任何涉及管道、排水或電路改動的列治文裝修工程均需列治文市建築許可證。地暖、新洗手台照明或排氣扇的電氣升級需要单独的電氣許可證。聚星裝修作為標準項目管理的一部分，處理所有許可證申請。

列治文主浴室裝修需要多長時間？

表面更新需時 3–4 週。新瓷磚及玻璃淋浴間的中檔裝修需時 6–10 週。涉及管道改動的全面翻新需時 10–16 週，從許可證申請到最終檢查。所有時間線均包含列治文市各檢查階段。

主浴室裝修中哪部分最貴？

淋浴區——尤其是防水、淋浴盤或無門檻系統、玻璃間隔或無框門，以及任何管道移動——通常是最大的單項費用。僅次於淋浴區的是定制木作及洗手台、地面材料及地暖系統。

在列治文裝修主浴室值得嗎？

中高端主浴室裝修通常可為列治文業主收回成本的 60–70%，基於該地區的可比較銷售數據。除轉售價值外，設計良好的主浴室顯著提升日常生活質量——尤其對主要套房居住者而言。全面翻新亦可消除隱藏結構問題的後期風險，如隱性黴菌、失效防水及可能需要緊急維修的過時管道。
